This is a nightly build, not a stable release. It has every change merged so far, and it may have bugs that a stable release would not. The stable app is on Google Play.

Download `vitapmate.apk` on your Android phone and open it. Android asks you once to allow installs from your browser or file manager. It runs on 64-bit ARM phones (nearly every phone from the last several years), Android 7.0 or newer.

If Android says the app conflicts with an installed copy (the Play Store app can be signed with another key), removing that copy fixes it but also removes its saved data.
